adobe_coreml_gpu_comparison.scope: network-only; identical structured inputs and recovered model parameters; no decode, calibration, stitching, model load or encoding
adobe_coreml_gpu_comparison.precision_note: Rust Metal uses FP32 shaders. Core ML CPU_AND_GPU uses the runtime defaults; GPU execution placement and internal arithmetic precision were not instrumented. This is not an equal-precision comparison or a whole Adobe Camera Raw application benchmark.

performance_pass_v3.scope: Matching structured 1024-square inputs and weights; retained models; inference only, no model load/file I/O; original and optimized executors ran sequentially with no concurrent builds or inference.
performance_pass_v3.guarantee_scope: All 16 same-device/driver fixture tensors preserve v2 GPU bits; not CPU bit-exactness, universal GPU determinism or Adobe parity.

native_smart_preview.scope: Single fresh-cache native addon integration runs, not repeated medians or HTTP/UI timings. Same X100VI source, amount100, 1600px smart-preview request.

adobe_runtime_investigation.static_observation_source: Existing Ghidra database, read-only focused decompilation through shell; separate from authenticated REA Evidence.

events.function: InterpolateFuji6x6(dng_host&, dng_negative&, dng_image const&, dng_image&, unsigned int, dng_vector const&)

runtime_replay.scope: controlled native replay; denoise amount100 enabled in launched process; prediction timers include LLDB entry/return overhead

adobe_runtime_investigation.timing_method: Core ML 9.0, one warmup and five predictions for each retained model/mode/API, sequential execution.
limits: Core ML anticipated device plan is not a runtime per-layer trace.
Native prediction timings include LLDB entry/return and adapter overhead; not whole-photo latency.
ComputeUnitsAll permits Neural Engine; observations do not establish GPU-only execution.
No equal-precision claim: Core ML internal arithmetic/storage precision was not forced to match Rust FP32.
Native amount100 was enabled only in the launched debug process; stopped after four predictions without a completed photo export.

previous_v2_diagnostics.scope: Original Bayer/X-Trans learned layers and weights with 256-square graph input geometry. Full 1024-square wrapper and whole-photo NVIDIA validation pending GPU reservation and VRAM headroom.

nvidia.scope: All five complete learned graphs, 16 original-geometry cases, previous-v2 and repeat exact checks, CPU numerical checks; complete 60-tile X100VI amount100 canonical camera-RGB wrapper exact against previous NVIDIA v2. Production API GPU image/overlay has not been deployed.
nvidia.guarantee_scope: Preserves previous NVIDIA GPU bits on this tested device/driver. The 16 prepared tensor fixtures also match saved Mac GPU bits; the complete RAW camera-RGB output differs across platforms for an unresolved reason. Neither CPU bit-exactness nor Adobe parity is claimed.

whole_x100vi_amount_100.scope: Complete canonical camera-RGB HWC f32 wrapper, amount100; compared with all 60 stitched previous NVIDIA v2 tiles. Excludes display rendering and model load.
whole_x100vi_amount_100.cross_platform_difference_cause: Not isolated; whole-RAW Mac/Linux bit parity is not established.

shared_gpu.qwen_tradeoff: Moving main-model layers to CPU slows generation; shared compute adds contention.

concurrent_memory.scope: Includes concurrent Qwen and previous v2/current v3 graph runs, including larger v2 arenas; not a v3-only memory peak.

shared_gpu.performance_scope: Diagnostic single CLI predictions under concurrent Qwen load, not isolated paired performance benchmarks. Earlier short Qwen request used a different prompt/length and is not a paired baseline.
shared_gpu.validation_environment: Temporary no-PVC pods; NVIDIA validation pod requested and limited one shared slot.
